payload._note: This filing is NOT for a SaaS company. Simulations Plus (ticker: SLP, CIK 0001023459) is a developer of pharmaceutical software and consulting services for drug discovery and development. While they do have some 'Software as a Service' revenue mentioned in Note 2 (Revenue Recognition), it represents 'a small portion of software revenues' and is not their primary business model. Their revenue comes primarily from perpetual software licenses (point-in-time recognition) and consulting services—not subscription-based SaaS. The filing contains NO SaaS-specific KPIs such as Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), or customer counts by segment. Revenue disaggregation shows software licenses ($36.5M total, with only $1.1M 'over time') and services ($23.1M), but these are NOT presented as SaaS metrics. There is no ARR growth disclosure, no cohort retention analysis, no bookings/billings metrics, and no top-customer concentration disclosure meeting the 10% threshold (Note 5 states no customer exceeded 10% of total revenue). This is a traditional enterprise software company, not a SaaS issuer.
